change: Adapt Sloppy 06a297d bounded decimal parsing and pointer-range trimming. Up to 18 decimal digits avoid per-digit overflow checks; other inputs keep the existing decimal/hexadecimal, separator, whitespace and overflow rules. No new base parameter or ints API.

validation.fuzz: Seeds 701..800 pass across five modes (500 executions) using the independent bootstrap.

checkpoint: 70 comparisons pass, two inconclusive, no established regression: all 12 compilation comparisons pass; 58/60 runtime comparisons pass. Default string equality and shifted-array comparisons against the preceding compiler are inconclusive. Keep both observations; no rerun or weakened thresholds.
performance: Two million signed decimal parses: default about 389 -> 45 ms, release 420 -> 41 ms; C strtoll with result checks about 76 ms. Short decimals, whitespace, hexadecimal, signed limits/overflow and malformed suffixes also improve. These results do not establish parity with every possible custom C parser.
artifact_limit: Adding the parser helper changes all 32 recorded executable artifacts, so the complete runtime set was timed on the laptop rather than claiming unchanged programs.
baseline: No whole-stage baseline promotion; fixed ea1cba0e and accepted cd07ea34 unchanged.
